title: తెలుగు Toolkit: All Utility
description:
Telugu Toolkit (తెలుగు టూల్‌కిట్) is your all-in-one daily utility app for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

From traditional village interest to live gold rates, land conversions, and utility calculators, get all essential tools in one fast, lightweight app.

KEY FEATURES & TOOLS:

1. Financial Calculators:
• Village Interest: Calculate monthly interest (₹2, ₹3 వడ్డీ per ₹100). Supports Simple & Compound Interest (చక్రవడ్డీ).
• Gold & Silver Rates: Daily live gold (22K, 24K) and silver market rates with GST and making charges.
• FD & RD: Fixed & Recurring Deposit returns with flexible compounding.
• Chit Fund: Monthly installments, commission, dividend, and net returns.
• PPF Calculator: 15-year Public Provident Fund growth and interest.
• EMI & Loan Comparison: Home, Car, and Personal loan EMIs. Compare two loans side-by-side.
• Salary Calculator: Gross pay, PF, PT, TDS deductions, and net in-hand monthly salary.
• GST Calculator: Inclusive and Exclusive GST for billing and retail.
• SIP Calculator: Systematic Investment Plan returns and wealth growth.

2. Land & Unit Converters:
• Land Converter: Convert Acres, Guntas, Cents, Gajalu (గజాలు), and Sq. Feet for AP & Telangana.
• Unit Converter: Length, Weight, Area, Temperature, Time, Data, and Volume.
• Number System: Decimal, Binary, Hex, and Octal converter.

3. Daily Utilities:
• Property Tax: GHMC and AP municipal property tax with rebate options.
• Water Bill: HMWSSB (Hyderabad) and AP slab-wise water bills and sewage fees.
• Vastu Compass: Digital compass showing Vastu directions (Eeshanyam, Agneyam, etc.).
• Age Calculator: Exact age in years, months, days, and birthday countdown.
• Fuel & Mileage: Trip fuel cost estimation based on distance and mileage.
• BMI Calculator: Body Mass Index with ideal weight tips.
• Unit Price Finder: Compare two items to find the best value deal.

4. Quick Portals & Helplines:
• State Portals: Easy links to Dharani (TS), Meebhoomi (AP), and Electricity bills (TGSPDCL / APEPDCL).
• Traffic E-Challan: Check traffic penalties for TS and AP.
• Emergency Helplines: Quick access to Police (100), Fire (101), Ambulance (108), and Women Helpline (181).

WHY TELUGU TOOLKIT?
• Bilingual: Switch between Telugu (తెలుగు) and English with one tap.
• Works Offline: Most calculators work 100% offline without internet.
• Clean & Modern UI: Fast, responsive design with Dark Mode support.
• Privacy First: No unnecessary permissions. Your data stays on your device.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMERS:
• Government Information: Telugu Toolkit is an independent private utility app. It is NOT affiliated with, authorized, or endorsed by any government entity. Links to public portals (Dharani, Meebhoomi, E-Challan) are provided for public convenience only, sourced directly from official public websites.
• Health & Fitness: The BMI Calculator is for informational purposes only and is not medical advice.
• Financial Services: Provides mathematical calculators only (Interest, EMI, GST). We do not provide or broker loans or financial products.

title: Hanuman Chalisa: Read & Listen
description:
Experience divine peace and spiritual strength with a modern, thoughtfully crafted devotional companion. Designed for devotees worldwide, this app brings sacred hymns, interactive daily rituals, and guided recitation into your daily routine.

Whether you are chanting in the morning, listening during commutes, or completing a personal vow, every feature is designed to be calm, respectful, and distraction-free.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
✨ KEY HIGHLIGHTS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🪔 Interactive Pocket Mandir
Begin your day with authentic temple rituals:
• Light the sacred Diya (automatically resets at midnight for your next morning prayer)
• Offer fresh flowers with a gentle touch
• Ring resonant temple brass bells and blow the sacred Shankh (conch)

📖 Multi-Language Recitation
Read verses with clear typography and verse-by-verse meanings across 11 languages:
• Telugu, Hindi, English, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Marathi, Bengali, Odia, and Urdu.

📜 Hands-Free Auto-Scroll & Text-to-Speech
• Enable smooth auto-scroll to recite comfortably without touching the screen.
• Listen to pronunciation verse-by-verse with integrated speech assistance.

🎧 Synchronized Audio & Lyric Chanting
• High-quality studio recitations with karaoke-style synchronized lyrics.
• Flexible repeat counters (1x, 3x, 7x, 11x, 21x, 108x) for japa and continuous meditation.
• Background audio playback with convenient lock-screen media controls.

🚩 Sankalpa Challenge (21 & 40 Days)
• Dedicate your prayers with specific intentions (health, peace, courage, prosperity, removal of obstacles).
• Track your consistency and build a long-lasting spiritual habit.

🌙 Sacred Temple Dark Mode
• High-contrast warm amber and golden palette crafted specifically for comfortable reading before dawn and late at night.

📅 Practice & Streak Tracker
• Monitor your daily reading progress, listen counts, and habit streaks.
• Daily verse cards with one-tap sharing to send morning blessings to family and friends.

📚 Complete Spiritual Library
Explore more sacred texts within one app:
• Bajrang Baan
• Sankat Mochan Hanuman Ashtak
• Aarti & Sundarkand selections
• Spiritual significance, benefits, and mythological katha

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🌿 DESIGNED WITH DEVOTION
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Works seamlessly offline once installed
• Minimal, respectful ad placement that never interrupts chanting
• Battery-optimized and fully compliant with Android 15 & 16

Bring peace, courage, and auspicious blessings into your life every day. 🙏

title: Vastu Compass: Home & Office
description:
Unlock Harmony and Prosperity with the Ultimate Spatial Wisdom Guide

Transform your living and working spaces into sources of positive energy with a comprehensive guide to ancient architectural principles. Whether you are moving into a new home, renovating an office, or optimizing your current layout, this tool provides the directional insights and traditional knowledge you need.

Key Features:

🧭 Precise Directional Compass
Go beyond basic navigation. Our accurate digital tool provides real-time mapping of traditional zones, including corresponding Deities and natural elements (Earth, Water, Fire, Air, Space) for every corner of your property.

🤖 Multilingual AI Assistant
Have a specific question about your layout? Chat with our intelligent assistant. Get instant, expert advice on room placements, remedies, and spatial adjustments—available in 12+ Indian languages including Hindi, Telugu, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, and more.

🏠 Room-by-Room Guidelines
Detailed tips and "Sacred Areas" mapping for every part of your home:

Entrance: Welcome positive energy through the right threshold.
Kitchen: Align the fire element for health and nutrition.
Master Bedroom: Enhance stability and peace for better rest.
Prayer Room: Create a sacred center for spiritual growth.
Wealth & Treasury: Positioning tips to attract prosperity and protect assets.
🌿 Modern Living Solutions
Practical advice for modern apartments and offices, covering Color Psychology, mirror placements, and the importance of the Brahmasthan (the central energy core).

🌐 12+ Languages Supported
Access traditional wisdom in your mother tongue. We support: English, हिन्दी (Hindi), తెలుగు (Telugu), বাংলা (Bengali), मराठी (Marathi), தமிழ் (Tamil), ગુજરાતી (Gujarati), اردو (Urdu), ಕನ್ನಡ (Kannada), ଓଡ଼ିଆ (Odia), മലയാളം (Malayalam), and ਪੰਜਾਬੀ (Punjabi).

✅ Ad-Free Experience
Enjoy a focused and peaceful study of your space. Watch a simple rewarded video to remove interruptions for up to 7 days, allowing you to optimize your environment in peace.

Why Choose This App?
The science of Vastu Shastra is about balancing the five elements of nature to bring health, wealth, and happiness. Our app combines this Vedic heritage with modern AI technology to give you a personalized directional guide in the palm of your hand.

Developed with ❤️ by Shankar Bros.

title: FloatPrompt: Teleprompter
description:
Read your scripts with ease while maintaining perfect eye contact with the camera.

Whether you are recording a vlog, presenting in a virtual meeting, or using a physical teleprompter glass rig, this app provides a clean and highly customizable script reading experience. Switch seamlessly between a classic full-screen display and a convenient floating widget overlay.

🌐 GLOBAL LANGUAGE SUPPORT
Speak and read in your native language! The app interface is fully localized and supports 12 major languages:

English, Español, Français, Deutsch, हिन्दी (Hindi), 中文 (Chinese), 日本語 (Japanese), العربية (Arabic), Русский (Russian), 한국어 (Korean), Bahasa Indonesia, and Português.
🌟 KEY FEATURES
1. Floating Widget Overlay
Multitask Seamlessly: Read your script while using your device's native camera app, social media recording tools, or video meeting platforms (such as Zoom, Teams, or Meet).
Adjustable Transparency: Control the opacity of the widget background so it doesn't block your view of other apps.
Fully Resizable & Draggable: Place the widget anywhere on your screen, keeping it close to your camera lens to maintain natural eye contact.
2. Classic Full-Screen Mode
Distraction-Free Reading: A dedicated full-screen layout designed for rehearsals, public speaking, presentations, and voiceovers.
Mirror / Reverse Text Support: Reverse the text horizontally to use the app with physical teleprompter glass rigs and beam splitter monitors.
3. Complete Text Customization
Adjustable Scroll Speed: Fine-tune the scrolling speed to match your natural speaking pace.
Font & Size Controls: Increase or decrease text size for comfortable reading at any distance.
Themes & Colors: Change the text color and background contrast to suit your lighting environment, including support for dark and light modes.
4. Easy Script Management
Quick Creation & Editing: Write, edit, and organize your scripts directly within the app.
Local Storage: Your scripts are stored securely on your device, ensuring privacy and offline accessibility.
🎬 WHO IS IT FOR?
Content Creators & Vloggers: Record high-quality videos for YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram without memorizing lines.
Business Professionals: Deliver polished presentations and participate in video calls without looking away from the screen.
Public Speakers: Rehearse speeches and adjust formatting to ensure a smooth, natural delivery.
Podcasters & Voice Artists: Read voiceover scripts without paper rustling sounds.
🔒 PRIVACY & PERMISSIONS
Draw Over Other Apps (SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW): This permission is strictly used to display the floating teleprompter widget over other apps.
Your scripts are kept locally on your device and are never shared or uploaded to external servers.

title: FTP Server: WiFi
description:
FTP Server: WiFi allows you to access and manage your Android device files over a local wireless network. By using the File Transfer Protocol (FTP), this utility eliminates the need for physical USB cables when moving photos, videos, or documents between your phone and a computer.

Functional Features

Wireless Access: View internal storage and SD card directories on any compatible device within the same WiFi/WLAN network.

Multi-Platform Support: Compatible with Windows File Explorer, macOS Finder, and Linux file managers.

Network Settings: Configurable port numbers and support for anonymous or password-protected login.

Storage Management: Copy, paste, delete, and backup files directly from your desktop interface.

Connection Guide

Connect your Android device and computer to the same WiFi network.

Launch the app and initialize the server to generate a local IP address.

Enter the provided FTP URL (e.g., ftp://192.168.1.5:2221) into your computer's file manager.

Technical Requirements

Stable WiFi connection.

Local network permissions enabled on the device.

No root access required.

title: Bubble Level: Pro Spirit Level
description:
Turn your smartphone into an industry-grade precision leveling toolkit!

Traditional spirit levels, bulky laser levels, and plumb bobs are essential for accurate work—but you rarely have them on hand when you need them. TrueLevel: Digital Precision Tool delivers heavy-duty workshop accuracy right in your pocket.

Engineered with an ultra-responsive industrial workshop interface, TrueLevel provides real-time sensor fusion with zero lag, ensuring your measurements are always 100% reliable.

🛠️ 6 SPECIALIZED PRECISION MODES

• 2D Bullseye Surface Level: 360° circular spirit level with concentric calibrated rings and liquid refraction for tables, floors, countertops, and appliances.
• 1D Horizontal Tubular Level (H): High-accuracy spirit vial along the bottom edge for wide shelving, timber, and framing.
• 1D Vertical Plumb Level (V): Side-edge tubular vial that auto-orients to either side of your phone for door frames, posts, and vertical studs.
• Smart Auto-Orientation: Seamlessly shifts between 2D, Horizontal, and Vertical levels using smart hysteresis without screen jitter or double-bubble ghosting.
• AR Laser Camera Level (Laser): Projects an augmented-reality laser guideline and reticle over your live camera feed. Works in both Portrait and Landscape to align paintings, tiles, and fixtures across entire rooms.
• Relative Angle Goniometer (Rel): Set a custom reference zero (Δ Relative Angle) to measure bevel cuts, roof pitches, or the exact angle between two surfaces.
• Calibrated Edge Ruler (Ruler): Physical touch-and-drag dual scale calibrated to your device’s screen DPI. Measure in millimeters, centimeters, and 1/16th-inch imperial units with real-time cursor readouts.

⚙️ PROFESSIONAL CONTRACTOR FEATURES

• Multiple Engineering Units: Instantly cycle between Degrees (°), Slope Percentage (%), Roof Pitch (in/ft), and Civil Grade (mm/m).
• Acoustic Radar & Reverse Beep: Dual-audio feedback! Choose between an arrival chime or an intelligent proximity radar that beeps faster as you near 0.0°—perfect when measuring overhead or behind walls where you can’t see the screen.
• Tactile Micro-Haptics: Feel a subtle vibration click the exact millisecond your tool hits dead level.
• Measurement Lock: Freeze your current reading on screen with one tap to inspect or transfer numbers to your blueprint.
• Independent 2-Axis Sensor Calibration: Calibrate out phone case bumps and camera bump angles on a known flat surface; reset to factory baseline anytime.
• Integrated LED Worklight: Toggle your phone’s flashlight directly from the tool header to work inside dark cabinets and crawlspaces.
• Global Language Support: Fully localized in 12 languages with native number formatting.

🏠 EVERYDAY & JOBSITE APPLICATIONS

• Home & Decor: Hang pictures, floating shelves, flat-screen TVs, and mirrors with laser-sharp alignment.
• Carpentry & Woodworking: Square cabinets, verify table saw bevels, assemble furniture, and true up stud walls.
• Construction & Roofing: Calculate roof pitches, driveway slopes, drainage gradients, and foundation grades.
• Photography & Video: Perfectly level tripods, match horizons, and set up overhead rig shots.
• RV & Camping: Level your motorhome, caravan, or campervan in seconds before setting camp.

💎 GO PRO FOR LIFE (NO SUBSCRIPTIONS!)

Tired of subscriptions? We believe essential tools should be owned, not rented. Upgrade to TrueLevel Pro for a small, one-time payment ($0.99) to unlock an ad-free workspace forever, with free lifetime updates included.

💡 PRO TIP FOR MAXIMUM ACCURACY
For the most precise results, use the Calibrate button on a level countertop once before your first jobsite measurement.

title: Morse Code Flash: SOS Survival
description:
Morse Code Flash is your ultimate tactical flashlight transmitter, telegraph key simulator, and interactive Morse code trainer. Whether you are signaling an emergency SOS in the wilderness, learning radio telegraphy, or practicing ham radio Q-codes, this all-in-one utility delivers instant, reliable communication.

⚡ OPTICAL FLASHLIGHT & SCREEN TRANSMITTER
• Flashlight Torch Blinker: Automatically translate any text into high-precision optical Morse light pulses using your camera LED torch.
• Emergency SOS Mode: Instant one-tap SOS strobe beacon designed for survival, hiking, camping, and emergency signaling.
• Fullscreen Screen Flasher: Transmit optical signals in high-visibility amber or bright white directly from your display when a flashlight isn't available.
• Adjustable Transmission Speed: Fine-tune WPM (Words Per Minute) and Farnsworth timing for beginner clarity or high-speed communication.

📻 TACTILE TELEGRAPH KEY & AUDIO SYNTHESIZER
• Real Straight Key: Experience manual telegraphy with a responsive tapping key (short tap for dot ·, hold for dash —).
• Realistic Audio Tones: Crystal-clear audio frequency synthesis with customizable pitch (400 Hz to 1000 Hz).
• Haptic Vibration Feedback: Feel every dot and dash with realistic physical haptic vibration responses.
• Soundpacks: Switch between classic CW sidetone, vintage radio clicks, and tactical beeps.

🎓 190+ INTERACTIVE CURRICULUM LEVELS
• Progressive Training: Master the international Morse alphabet step-by-step using proven auditory recognition methods.
• Listen & Identify Mode: Hear the signal, watch the rhythm, and identify letters on an interactive tactical keyboard.
• Transmission Mode: Practice your keying rhythm by tapping target letters and words with precision timing feedback.
• Prosigns & Q-Codes: Advance beyond the basics to master procedural signals (AR, AS, SK, BK) and radio Q-codes (QTH, QSL, QRM).
• Instant Feedback: Immediate audio-visual guidance with animated speaker ripples, error indicators, and rhythm hints.

📖 COMPLETE MORSE CODE DICTIONARY
• Quick lookup dictionary for letters (A–Z), digits (0–9), punctuation, and emergency prosigns.
• One-tap preview to hear and flash any character instantly.

🔥 DAILY CODEBREAKER & GAMIFICATION
• Daily Secret Transmission: Crack a new encrypted daily Morse word to earn bonus XP and maintain your daily streak.
• Streaks & XP: Track your learning mastery and unlock tactical themes (Amber CRT, Phosphor Green, Cyber Cyan, Solar Gold).

🌲 100% OFFLINE & SURVIVAL READY
• No Internet Required: All transmitter tools, dictionary entries, and training levels function completely offline without cell signal.
• Zero Account Hassle: No registration, no login, and no personal data collection.

Equip your device with the essential light and sound Morse communicator. Download Morse Code Flash today!

title: TimeSeal: GPS Timestamp Camera
description:
TimeSeal is the heavy-duty GPS timestamp camera engineered for civil engineering, construction verification, utility audits, land surveying, field inspections, and legal documentation.

Capture tamper-evident photos and HD video with live GPS coordinates, reverse-geocoded addresses, compass azimuth heading, altitude, and project notes embedded permanently onto every frame.

FIELD-READY FEATURE SUITE

HIGH-PRECISION GPS & COORDINATES
• Dual Coordinate Systems: Decimal Degrees (DD) and Degrees Minutes Seconds (DMS)
• Live Fix Accuracy: View satellite fix tolerance (±m/ft) directly on the stamp
• Elevation Tracking: Altitude measurement relative to sea level
• Automated Reverse Geocoding: Auto-stamp street address, city, state, and country
• Embedded GPS Mini-Map: Aerial mini-map watermark with directional heading beam

MILITARY-GRADE TIMESTAMPING
• Millisecond Precision: Evidentiary-grade time synchronization with millisecond toggle
• Global Date Formats: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), European (DD/MM/YYYY), and US (MM/DD/YYYY)
• 12-Hour & 24-Hour Clock: Toggle standard AM/PM and 24-hour military time
• Sequential Indexing: Optional sequential shot numbering (#0001) for chain of custody

SENSORS & LEVELING HUD
• 360° Magnetic Compass: Live azimuth heading with cardinal points
• Pitch & Roll Indicators: Digital leveling sensors ensure calibrated captures
• Industrial UI: High-contrast gunmetal and safety yellow design tuned for bright sunlight

MULTI-LANGUAGE & GLOBAL READY
• Native Localization: Full support for international crews and multi-regional teams
• In-App Language Switch: Easily toggle English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Hindi, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Indonesian, Vietnamese, and more
• Fast Onboarding: Select language on first launch or switch anytime in settings

PROJECT PROFILES & BRANDING
• Project Templates: Quick-switch between Civil, Survey, Logistics, or custom profiles
• Custom Metadata: Overlay Project Title, Contractor Name, Inspector ID, and Notes
• Custom Company Logo: Import and stamp your company logo directly onto the card
• Card Placement: Dock watermark at Top-Left, Top-Right, Bottom-Left, or Bottom-Right
• Styling Controls: Customize font size, card opacity, and border styling

DUAL CAPTURE (PHOTO & VIDEO)
• High-Resolution Photos: High-fidelity sensor output with zero compression loss
• Live Stamped Video: Record HD video with real-time updating timestamp, coordinates, and HUD
• Hardware EXIF Writer: Embeds GPS, altitude, capture datetime, device model, and tags into JPEG EXIF headers for desktop GIS, AutoCAD, and Google Earth integration
• Quick-Access Preview: In-app thumbnail for instant verification of captured media

100% PRIVATE & OFFLINE
• Zero Cloud Transmission: Photos, videos, coordinates, and notes stay locally on your device
• Fully Offline Ready: Works reliably in remote job sites without cell service
• Ad-Free Pro Option: One-time upgrade to remove ads for uninterrupted fieldwork

PERFECT FOR EVERY INDUSTRY
• Civil Engineering & Infrastructure
• Construction Progress & Safety Audits
• Telecom, Fiber Optic & Utility Verification
• Real Estate & Cadastral Land Surveying
• Insurance Adjusters & Damage Appraisals
• Delivery Logistics & Proof of Delivery
• Environmental & Mining Inspections

Equip your field teams with TimeSeal — the indisputable standard in GPS timestamp evidence.
